about: Batch 9 (4 Nov 2026). The owner: 'use the weigh-in for the tracks we have it and then evaluate if we can cover other tracks with our model or just leave them alone'; 'define a predicted weight for each dog today based on historic patterns' from 'weight last run, historic weight patterns, recency, form'. No pre-race weigh-in source reaches us (greyhounds.today empty since 7 Oct; GBGB fills the weight in with the result), so: the live recipe (batch 8: RMSE of log(BSP) 0.4127, the per-track stretch 0.4053) scored per track (each track its own group: the gap to the BSP and the RMSE, for cover or leave); the same with the predicted weigh-in (greyhound/blocks/wpred.py, its yearly out-of-sample R2 in the log); the same with the real weigh-in (the ceiling no live source gives us today); and the live recipe through the trade-out study (does our price add to the market at first traded, 5 and 3 minutes out). The cache is rebuilt (refresh) to keep the raw weight the predicted weigh-in reads.
